name: ZENTECH
recent: Zen Tech 最近因诽谤诉讼被判向前董事经理支付 RM200,000，同时外部审计师因未付审计费而辞职。公司截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩显示净亏损 RM3.066m，主要受手套业务拖累。此外，公司更改了财政年度结束日，并有一项多项提案待处理。
notable: 公司被令向前董事经理 Mohd Anuar 支付 RM200,000 诽谤赔偿。
外部审计师因未付审计费而辞职。
公司更改财政年度结束日。
risks: 公司面临诽谤诉讼判决，需支付 RM200,000。
外部审计师辞职，可能影响财务报告审计。
最新季度净亏损 RM3.066m，手套业务表现疲弱。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，公司营收为 RM11.341m，环比增长10.0%，但同比下降17.1%；净亏损为 RM1.168m，净亏损率为10.3%，较上一季度的96.1%亏损率有所收窄。

recent_en: Zen Tech was recently ordered to pay RM200,000 to a former managing director in a defamation suit, while its external auditor resigned over unpaid audit fees. The company reported a net loss of RM3.066m for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, dragged by its glove segment. It also changed its financial year end and has multiple proposals pending.
notable_en: The company was ordered to pay RM200,000 in defamation damages to former managing director Mohd Anuar.
The external auditor resigned due to unpaid audit fees.
The company changed its financial year end.
risks_en: The company faces a defamation judgment requiring payment of RM200,000.
The external auditor resigned, which may affect audit of financial reports.
The latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM3.066m, with weak glove segment performance.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM11.341m, up 10.0% QoQ but down 17.1% YoY; net loss was RM1.168m with a net margin of -10.3%, narrowing from a -96.1% margin in the previous quarter.
